purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official Punjab PULSE Cadastral Maps layer 25 (Okara) returns one complete polygon at the exact WUP locator. OBJECTID 10854687 is an esriFieldTypeOID transport identity; metadata reports objectIdField/globalIdField null. Khasra_ID and Mouza_ID are both zero. Geometry is therefore verified while legal parcel identity/runtime qualification remain separate and unresolved.
registryAssessment: Official Punjab Land Records and Punjab PULSE provide village-based cadastral map services. The exact WUP feature response establishes public polygon geometry in the Okara layer; it does not establish a valid cadastral parcel identifier or legal boundary.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Punjab Land Records cadastral map page offers district/tehsil/village selectors.
Official Punjab PULSE map lists cadastral-map layers and cautions that mapped lines are indicative, not legal boundaries.
Okara polygon layer metadata returned HTTP 200; fields were reviewed and unsafe owner/account-type fields excluded from queries.

Exact WUP query returned HTTP 200 polygon response; safe IDs Khasra_ID and Mouza_ID were both zero, so it does not verify a valid parcel. A 200m nearby query restricted to Khasra_ID > 0 returned no features.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A complete full polygon is verified at the WUP locator. OBJECTID 10854687 is available as a service transport value, while objectIdField/globalIdField metadata are null and Khasra_ID/Mouza_ID are zero. Stability and legal parcel correspondence are unqualified. The viewer disclaimer concerns legal boundary status and does not negate geometry retrieval.

geometryDisposition: One complete full polygon retained because official layer metadata confirmed an Okara polygon Feature Layer and the exact WUP query returned a full 41-vertex ring. Preserve OBJECTID 10854687 only as the raw service OID; do not promote it to a native legal parcel key. Khasra_ID and Mouza_ID remain their returned zero values. Runtime identity qualification remains unresolved.
